Over this period, defect densities are expected to drop linearly  
from 1.5 defects/cm? to 0.8 defects/cm*.The cost of 6-inch  
A) wafer production will fall linearly from \$5,000 to \$3,500, and  
the cost of 8-inch wafer production will fall linearly from (5)  
\$10,000 to \$6,500. Assume production of good devices is  
constant in each year. Which production process should be  
chosen?
